## EdgeLiveStreamDetailsOptions.audioTransmitStream property

An optional `MediaStream` containing one or more audio tracks, for audio transmission to the device, e.g. the stream returned by `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio: true})`<!-- -->. If not set, audio will not be transmitted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
audioTransmitStream?: MediaStream;
```
